newsitem.title: UK: NatWest up as Credit Lyonnais repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: NatWest up as Credit Lyonnais repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in British bank NatWest rose on Friday after Credit Lyonnais Laing reiterated its "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.

NatWest shares touched 712p and were trading at 711p by 1022 GMT, up 15-1/2p on the day and outstripping the broader market's 0.44 percent rise. Almost three million shares had changed hands by that time.
Market sources said Credit Lyonnais Laing believed banks in general had more growth potential than realised and said NatWest, with the Gartmore fund management group, was in a strong position.
